per_claim_classifications.claim: The claimed 4h coverage excess based on N-bars x timeframe is not a valid coverage calculation.
per_claim_classifications.evidence: Rejection confirmed quantitatively. 4h: 1,169 bars x 4 h = 194.83 bar-days; 1h: 4,406 occupied hours = 183.58 days. The 270-hour excess equals exactly the 270 hourly sub-buckets that are unoccupied at 1h granularity but sit inside 197 partially-occupied 4h buckets (972 of 1,169 4h bars have all four sub-buckets occupied). bars x width counts empty sub-buckets as covered whenever any tick lands in the coarser bucket; it is not an observed-coverage estimator. No coverage defect exists: all seven strata span the identical wall-clock window (last 2026-05-05T12:00-12:38:45Z; first bar closes 2025-07-31T16:00:15Z-20:00:00Z under the development view's effective 16:00:00Z start boundary, which precedes the frozen 16:15:00Z scope boundary - see freeze_corrections).

per_claim_classifications.claim: FILL E1B is justified but lower priority.
per_claim_classifications.evidence: Fill event stream verified complete and correctly attributed (payload fill events = recorded + orphan fills at every stratum; orphans classified as left truncation; A1 gap-through fills legitimately belong to the fill cohort and are self-documenting via first_touch_observed=false). decision_rationale.E1A_FORMATION_PHENOTYPE: PASS. The formation cohort and every headline phenotype statistic reproduce exactly from the zone rows; determinism re-verified (run-1/run-2 byte-identical); the two mandatory anomaly audits resolved without any scanner defect (A1 EXPECTED_SEMANTIC_CASE 1,010/1,010; A2 LEFT_TRUNCATED_PRE_DEVELOPMENT_STATE 533/533, zero unexplained); the research reconstruction handled both cases faithfully (fail-closed identity validation, no fabricated touches, orphans excluded from cohorts by construction). Freeze may proceed with two annotations: (a) formed_fill_without_prior_touch_n must be labeled a producer-semantic gap-through-fill case, not an unexplained anomaly; (b) orphan_touch_n/orphan_fill_n must be labeled pre-development left-truncated state. The director reconciliation sentence "a filling bar necessarily overlaps the zone" is factually wrong under the linked producer code and must not enter any frozen text.
decision_rationale.FIRST_TOUCH_E1B: BLOCKED, per the challenge rule for the observed A1 outcome: the lake legitimately omits first-touch while preserving fill, so FIRST_TOUCH E1B remains blocked until the measurement contract is defined. The anomaly itself is fully resolved (no data defect), so the only remaining item is the contract, which must state: (1) the touch-cohort denominator (zones with a recorded first touch, per stratum); (2) the treatment of gap-through-fill zones that never emit a touch (excluded from touch-anchored cohorts and reported separately via the fill payload first_touch_observed=false flag; they must not be silently imputed); (3) the anchor clock (market vs known time), given the paired-delay distributions now on record. Once the director freezes that contract, FIRST_TOUCH E1B is unblocked with no further audit required.
decision_rationale.FILL_E1B: READY. The fill event stream is complete and correctly attributed; A1 rows belong in fill cohorts (their fills are genuine far-edge reaches); A2 orphan fills are pre-development state already excluded from cohorts. Registration caveats: survivor-conditioning at 1h/4h (7.84%/15.57% right-censored) must be stated; anchor clock and same-bar touch+fill handling pre-registered; second priority after FIRST_TOUCH in one E1B stage-anchor extension.
decision_rationale.QUESTION_GENERATOR_ELIGIBILITY: PARTIAL. Eligible as registered hypotheses requiring formal nulls: the direction-adjusted negative-median pattern (18/21 cells, non-positive 19/21, magnitude growing with horizon and scale), the bullish-share gradient (0.5103 to 0.6048), the tail characterization beyond p95, censored-population heterogeneity, and the paired clock-delay structure. NOT eligible: any edge/alpha/profitability framing; the 4h h5 (+12.508 bps, n=167) or 1h h3 (+0.852 bps, n=523) cells as findings; any lifetime-fill-probability reading of observed fill fractions; any cross-scale pooling or cross-scale zone identity.

prospective_response_assessment.zero_cell: 15s h1, median exactly 0.0 (frozen table serializes -0.0; sign-bit artifact).
prospective_response_assessment.question_generator_entry: Yes, as DESCRIPTIVE_DIRECTIONAL_ASYMMETRY worth later testing: the sign split is the signature of window drift plus a mild counter-directional median tendency after formation, present in both direction cohorts at nearly all scales and horizons. It is scientifically interesting enough for Question Generator entry as a hypothesis family (zero-median tests per stratum x horizon; drift-aware nulls; gap_atr/quality conditionals), and explicitly NOT as an edge, alpha, or reversal effect. No E2 run, no formal confirmation performed in this audit.

tail_censor_recommendation.p95_distortion: Material at 1h and 4h: right-censoring (7.84% / 15.57%) removes precisely the slowest zones, so the observed-fill p95 conditions on the fastest 92.2% / 84.4% of the population and the unconditional p95 is NOT identifiable from this window (max identifiable unconditional quantile = 1 - censor_rate). At 15s-15m (censor 0.45-4.01%) the unconditional p95 is identifiable and is 1.2x-5.1x the frozen observed-fill p95 in native bars (15s 857 vs 717; 30s 870 vs 695; 1m 996 vs 669; 5m 1,471 vs 701; 15m 2,835 vs 561) because the tail is extremely fat. The frozen p95s are therefore systematically conservative descriptions of the tail at every stratum, and materially censored-conditioned statistics at 1h/4h.
tail_censor_recommendation.e1b_additions: Add, per stratum, with no new framework: (1) p99 and max of formation_to_fill and formation_to_touch market durations; (2) unconditional-denominator quantiles (censored = unfilled), which under this design's single-end administrative censoring equal the Kaplan-Meier estimate for all t below the window end and are identifiable up to 1 - censor_rate; (3) an explicit "max identifiable unconditional quantile = 1 - censor_rate" line per stratum so no one reads coarse tails as identified. A full survival-model framework is NOT warranted.
tail_censor_recommendation.claim3_status: "Rapid body + long tail" SURVIVED and is understated, not distorted: the body claim (2-bar touch, 5-8 bar fill medians) is exact; the tail extends 1-2 orders of magnitude beyond p95 (p99 up to 14,176 bars; max observed 682,740 bars at 15s).
